title: Proposed extended muster_set_availability input
description: Proposed text-tool extension, not implemented behavior. Defaults are recommendations pending owner decisions. Authorization, time conversion, full-answer safety, payload-byte limits and conditional persistence require server enforcement.

event_id.description: Canonical or short event ID. The authenticated caller determines whose answer changes.

availability.description: Legacy whole-answer available marks, extended with explicit weekly shorthand. Null preserves legacy argument-presence handling; it is not an empty array.

if_needed.description: Legacy whole-answer if-needed marks, extended with explicit weekly shorthand. A present nonnull list still invokes the documented whole-answer replacement semantics.

ranges.description: Proposed half-open ranges [start,end). This key forbids both legacy list keys, even when those keys are null. Empty ranges are structurally valid; no-op versus replacement semantics require the documented owner decision.

mode.description: Recommended default only, not an approved policy or an instruction for validators to mutate input. Merge requires ranges; legacy list inputs support replace only.

expected_state_fingerprint.description: Optional opaque comparison value, not an authorization token. The server must apply the approved freshness/conditional-write contract.

weekday.description: New creation generates Monday through Sunday as 2018-06-18 through 2018-06-24. Set resolves the unique matching stored reference weekday/time, including legacy June-17 Sunday; ambiguity requires an explicit instant. Existing raw dates retain validation behavior.

time.description: 24-hour HH:mm. Reference-UTC clock interpretation is proposed, pending owner approval; a display timezone must not silently change stored instants.

weeklySlot.description: Permitted by the server only for dow or a validated reference-week group. Never infer recurrence for actual-date, undated or ambiguous groups.

oneOf.description: RFC3339 slot-start instant with explicit offset; normalized by the server.

state.description: Assignment for each covered grid slot. Unavailable means absent from both editable mark lists, not a third persisted availability layer.

range.description: Server checks positive span, current-grid alignment, membership, conflicting overlaps and expanded mark limits.
